Good morning, Professor Alvarez — I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. In my free time these slots are open: Monday 14:00-14:30, Wednesday 10:00-10:30, Wednesday 13:00-13:30, Wednesday 15:00-15:30. Would one of them work for you? If not, tell me when you're free and I'll fit it in.

— Sarah

Good morning, Sarah. All four of your slots are free on my side, so let's take the first: **Monday 14:00-14:30**. I've put it in my calendar — see you then.

— Professor Alvarez

Perfect — Monday 14:00-14:30 is on my calendar too, and I've logged it. See you then.

— Sarah
